title: What is the best way to do animation in 3d for Unity
author: Liserkon
selftext:
I am working on a 3d game in Unity and was wondering what are the current best tools to work on animations for the game

I have both Humanoid and Humanoid+( multiple limbs or animal parts) characters.

Is there any tools out already that can assist in making them unique and interesting.

I have attempted creating tolls to do it, with some progress. But overall it is taking major effort to get them to the desired levels.

I have been considering doing animation through video/ mocap.

Any suggestions you guys might have is welcome.

comments.author: skill-tap
comments.body: Check out mcp server with blender, might check the right boxes for you.

replies.author: Liserkon
replies.body:
I have been considering this option 
Would I need to adjust the workflow?
Currently working with Unity and created a rigging tool through codex
Would I need to move all that to MCP?
I have been using free Maximo animations currently, super generic looking 
My main goal and difficulty is to animate a winged human, has anyone done something similar?

replies.author: skill-tap
replies.body: Winged suggests the rigging is the best thing to nail down first. You could model in blender, import the model and keep rigging the same way. You could also spec your current rig as the intended output. Like, export the rig data from unity, bring into blender mcp as a target template.
